# https://github.com/huggingface/text-embeddings-inference/blob/v1.9.4/README.md#supported-models
# ghcr.io/huggingface/text-embeddings-inference@sha256:8419f533857b503ebf6ec292a95d4f1cf9c0464ac8b8abeef39518cf110e5726
# Written by hand: the config.json architecture of each model type the
# README lists, taken from its example models where it names one. Loomplane
# runs TEI on CPU only, so Mistral and Qwen2 are left out: TEI 1.9.4
# refuses them without CUDA (backends/candle/src/lib.rs at v1.9.4).
#
# Text embeddings
BertModel
CamembertModel
Gemma3TextModel
GteModel
JinaBertForMaskedLM
JinaBertModel
ModernBertForMaskedLM
ModernBertModel
MPNetForMaskedLM
MPNetModel
NewModel
NomicBertModel
Qwen3ForCausalLM
RobertaModel
XLMRobertaModel
#
# Sequence classification and re-ranking. TEI treats any architecture
# ending in "Classification" as a classifier (router/src/lib.rs at v1.9.4),
# which is how BERT cross-encoders load although the README doesn't name
# them.
BertForSequenceClassification
CamembertForSequenceClassification
ModernBertForSequenceClassification
NewForSequenceClassification
RobertaForSequenceClassification
XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification
